definitions.job_s: job started_at to completed_at from the GitHub API: the whole job, with setup and post steps
definitions.queue_s: job created_at to started_at from the GitHub API: the wait for a runner
definitions.to_first_step_s: job created_at to the first step's started_at
definitions.ratio: baseline median job time divided by candidate median job time; above 1 means the candidate was faster
definitions.cold: no Actions cache entry exists for the branch the run is on
definitions.warm: run on a branch whose cache was filled by one earlier run of the same job
